corpus.text: Institute for Art and Culture (IAC) is a federally chartered and HEC recognized institute in Pakistan, established under Act No. XXXI of 2018. Since 2018, its programs have been defining creative education in Pakistan. IAC describes itself as a community of makers, thinkers, pioneers and storytellers redesigning the future, with a global network influencing learning, culture, industry and society.

IAC's mission is to encourage excellence in teaching and research by offering academic programs and diverse approaches that prepare students to intellectually interact and explore innovation in performance and creative work. IAC promotes multidisciplinary integration of arts, culture, and technology through creativity, critical thinking, and technological innovation.

IAC's vision is to engage and incorporate a diverse group of students, community members, faculty, and staff to maintain a firm ground for achieving excellence in diversified and multidisciplinary fields of arts, culture, and technology, fostering an artistic, creative, critical, and effective thought process.

IAC operates under the structure '5 Schools, 1 University': 1) School of Architecture, Design & Urbanism (SADU), 2) School of Art (SOA), 3) School of Informatics and Robotics (SIR), 4) School of Digital & Cinematic Art (SDCA), 5) School of Culture and Languages.

IAC contact details: Phone (042) 111 111 822; Email info@iac.edu.pk; Address: 7.5 KM from Thokar Niaz Baig, Main Raiwind Road, Bhobtian, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (next to Govt. Technical College). Social media: Instagram @iacofficials, Facebook facebook.com/iacofficials, X/Twitter @iacofficials, LinkedIn linkedin.com/school/iacofficials, YouTube @instituteforartandculture8336.

IAC educational and global partnerships include: IAC & HUM TV (media collaboration), CEE - Ozyegin University Istanbul, Turkey, Alliance with RUBIKA (France, for animation/game design), IU Germany, and membership/association with the Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU).

Sports at IAC include eSports, Cricket, Football, Table Tennis, Badminton, and Gym. IAC also hosts an annual Art & Cultural Week featuring sports competitions (Cricket, Football, Badminton, Table Tennis, Spoon Race, Tug of War, Musical Chair), E-Games (Tekken, FIFA, Call of Duty, Valorant), and cultural events (Theater/Mime, Urdu/English Debates, Mushaira, Music Performance, Fashion Show, Social Night).

Students can apply to IAC through the online Admission Portal at eduboard.iac.edu.pk/AdmissionPortal/Login. IAC also has a Student Portal for currently enrolled students at eduboard.iac.edu.pk/StudentPortal/Login. Prospective students can browse programs, download the prospectus, and review the fee structure before applying. Admissions staff include Hina Naseem (Assistant Manager Admissions) and Alisha Nawaz (Admission Associate).

IAC offers multiple levels of academic programs: Undergraduate (Bachelor's) programs, Postgraduate (Master's) programs, Associate Degree Programs (ADP), Post-Associate Degree Programs (Post-ADP), one-year Professional Diplomas, and 3-6 month Short Courses/Certificates.

IAC provides student facilities: Accommodation, Fees and Funding (Financial Aid), Transport services, a Day Care Center, the Center for Well Being & Positive Psychology (CW&PS), and a Cafeteria. Additional resources include a Library, a downloadable Prospectus, an Academic Calendar, and Scholarships & Financial Aid.

The School of Architecture, Design and Urbanism (SADU) at IAC is led by Dean Dr. Muhammad Yusuf Awan. SADU blends creativity, technology, and practical experience, offering architecture, design, and urban studies programs that combine theory and practice. The school uses an innovative curriculum incorporating Artificial Intelligence, practical studios, and real-world internships.
SADU offers Bachelor's programs: Bachelor of Architecture, Bachelor of Interior Design, Bachelor of Construction Management, and Bachelor of Tourism, Hospitality and Culinary Arts.

SADU Associate Degree Programs: Associate Degree in Interior Design, and Associate Degree in Construction Management. SADU Graduate (Master's) Programs: Master in Interior Design, and Master of Architecture (M.Arch).

SADU professional diplomas and short courses: Certificate in Culinary Arts / Professional Chef (3 months), Certificate in Bakery & Patisserie Making (3 months), Diploma in Professional Cooking & Baking (1 year), Certificate in Restaurant Manager (6 months), Certificate in Tourism & Hospitality Management (6 months).

The School of Art at IAC is led by Dean Prof. Dr. Shahida Manzoor. It offers programs in Graphic Design, Textile Design, Fashion Design, and Interdisciplinary Art & Design, combining theory and practical experience with foreign-qualified faculty and modern studios.

School of Art Bachelor's programs: Bachelor of Graphic Design, Bachelor of Interdisciplinary Art and Design, Bachelor of Textile Design, Bachelor of Fashion Design. Associate Degree Programs: Associate Degree in Graphic Design, Associate Degree in Fashion Design, Associate Degree in Textile Design.
School of Art short courses include: Fashion Design, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Traditional Arts, Textile Design, and Drawing.

The School of Informatics and Robotics (SIR) at IAC is led by Dean Prof. Dr. Shazia Saqib. SIR offers BS Computer Science, ADP Computer Science, Post-ADP Computer Science, and MS Computer Science programs focused on Programming, AI, Robotics, and Data-Driven Innovation, with modern labs, project-based learning, and industry linkages.

SIR undergraduate program: Bachelor of Computer Science. Associate Degree: Associate Degree in Computer Science. Master's program: Master in Computer Science. Short courses: Programming for AI (Artificial Intelligence), and MERN Stack Full-Stack Web Development.

The School of Digital & Cinematic Art (SDCA) at IAC is led by Acting Associate Dean Dr. Asim Manzoor. SDCA offers Bachelor's programs in Film & TV, Game Design, and Animation Design, with international collaboration with Rubika (France), expert faculty, on-campus studios, and industry workshops. Students use tools like Maya, Blender, and Adobe Suite.
SDCA Bachelor's programs: Bachelor of Game Design, Bachelor of Film and Television, Bachelor of Animation Design. Associate Degree Program: Associate Degree in Film & TV.

SDCA short courses include: 60 Second Film Production, Vlogging, Photography, Mobile Game Marketing, Game Design for Mobile, Character Design for Animation, Visual Communication, Sound Mastery, Podcast Production, Fundamentals of Game Design, 3D Modeling (Fundamentals of Games), Designing Mobile Game UI/UX, Fundamentals of Unreal Engine, Learn to Illustrate (Drawing Fundamentals), and AR/VR Techniques.

The School of Culture and Languages at IAC is led by Dr. Shabbir Ahmad Rana (Professor/Head, Center for Wellbeing and Positive Psychology). Its BS in Psychology program, with a specialization in Positive Psychology, is among the first of its kind in the region, focusing on well-being, resilience, and human flourishing.
School of Culture and Languages Bachelor's programs: Bachelor in Psychology (with specialization in Positive Psychology), Bachelor in English Language and Literature, and Bachelor in Popular Culture.

IAC's Bachelor's degree programs across all schools: Bachelor of Architecture; Bachelor of Interior Design; Bachelor of Construction Management; Bachelor of Tourism, Hospitality and Culinary Arts (SADU) | Bachelor of Graphic Design; Bachelor of Interdisciplinary Art and Design; Bachelor of Textile Design; Bachelor of Fashion Design (School of Art) | Bachelor of Computer Science (SIR) | Bachelor of Game Design; Bachelor of Film and Television; Bachelor of Animation Design (SDCA) | Bachelor in Psychology; Bachelor in English Language and Literature; Bachelor in Popular Culture (School of Culture and Languages).
IAC's Master's (graduate) programs: Master in Interior Design; Master of Architecture (M.Arch) (SADU) | Master in Computer Science (SIR).

IAC's Associate Degree Programs (ADP): Associate Degree in Interior Design; Associate Degree in Construction Management (SADU) | Associate Degree in Graphic Design; Associate Degree in Fashion Design; Associate Degree in Textile Design (School of Art) | Associate Degree in Computer Science (SIR) | Associate Degree in Film & TV (SDCA).

Notable IAC events: 'Voices, Vision, and Leadership: Women Transforming Creative Arts, Architecture, Film, and Technology' conference under Chancellor Prof. Dr. Najma Najam at IAC Auditorium; IAC x JS Bank MoU for Fee Digitalization; ART & CULTURAL WEEK; Fall 2025 Thesis Display Inauguration; Final Thesis Exhibitions for Bachelor of Interior Design and Bachelor of Architecture; and the 2nd Convocation 2026.

IAC's Chancellor is Prof. Dr. Najma Najam. The website references a Pro-Vice Chancellor Message page, an IAC Charter (established under Act No. XXXI of 2018), a Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC), Student Affairs office, Registrar Office, Controller Examination Office, HR Department, Office of the Treasurer, and IT Department.
IAC's campus is located 7.5 KM from Thokar Niaz Baig, on Main Raiwind Road, in Bhobtian, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan - next to the Government Technical College.

All fee figures are for the Spring 2026 admission cycle at IAC, quoted in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Every program requires a one-time, non-refundable Admission Fee of PKR 20,000 and a refundable Security Deposit of PKR 20,000, paid at admission, in addition to total tuition fee. Withholding Tax was omitted by the Finance Act 2022, but may be reinstated. Fee amounts from the 2nd semester onward are subject to change based on enrollment, selected subjects, and practical courses.

Overall fee summary - SADU: Bachelor of Architecture total PKR 2,032,000; Bachelor of Interior Design PKR 1,468,000; BS in Construction Management PKR 1,420,000; Bachelor of Tourism, Hospitality & Culinary Arts PKR 1,190,000.
Overall fee summary - SDCA: Bachelor of Film & TV total PKR 1,291,500; Bachelor of Animation Design PKR 1,295,500; Bachelor of Game Design PKR 1,265,500.

Overall fee summary - School of Art: Bachelor of Interdisciplinary Arts & Design PKR 1,332,500; Bachelor of Fine Art PKR 1,358,500; Bachelor of Graphic Design PKR 1,378,500; Bachelor of Textile Design PKR 1,326,500; Bachelor of Fashion Design PKR 1,346,500.
Overall fee summary - SIR: BS in Computer Science PKR 969,000; BS in Interaction Design PKR 960,000.
Overall fee summary - Graduate Studies: Master of Architecture PKR 485,000; Master in Interior Design PKR 459,000.

Overall fee summary - Associate Degree Programmes: ADP Computer Science PKR 530,000; ADP Fashion Design PKR 675,000; ADP Graphic Design PKR 693,000; ADP Interior Design PKR 673,000; ADP Textile Design PKR 637,000; ADP Construction Management PKR 750,000; ADP Film & TV PKR 620,500.

Detailed fee breakdown - Bachelor of Architecture: 52 courses, 180 credits, total tuition PKR 1,892,000, misc charges PKR 100,000, admission PKR 20,000, security PKR 20,000, grand total PKR 2,032,000.

Detailed fee breakdown - Bachelor of Interior Design: 47 courses, 134 credits, total tuition PKR 1,148,000, misc charges PKR 80,000, admission PKR 20,000, security PKR 20,000, grand total PKR 1,268,000.
Detailed fee breakdown - BS in Computer Science: 48 courses, 141 credits, total tuition PKR 849,000, misc charges PKR 80,000, admission PKR 20,000, security PKR 20,000, grand total PKR 969,000.
Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) at IAC: Duration 5 Years / 10 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 180.

Bachelor of Architecture Semester 1 courses: GED-101 Functional English 3(3+0); GED-102 Quantitative Reasoning I 3(3+0); GED-103 Islamic/Religious Studies/Ethics 2(2+0); GED-104 Applications of ICT 3(2+1); ARC-101 Foundation Studio I 6(0+6); SOC-101 Introduction to Soft Skills 3(2+1); GED-100 Nazara-e-Quran 0(0+0).
Bachelor of Interior Design (B.ID) at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 134.
BS in Construction Management (CMT) at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 134.
Bachelor of Studies in Tourism, Hospitality & Culinary Arts (BS-THCA) at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 136.
Bachelor of Graphic Design at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 139.
Bachelor of Fashion Design at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 139.
Bachelor of Game Design (Game Design & Development) at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 137.
Bachelor of Film and Television (FTV) at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 137.
Bachelor of Animation Design at IAC: Duration 4 Years / 8 Semesters; Total Credit Hours: 137.

The School of Informatics and Robotics (SIR) at IAC is led by Dean Prof. Dr. Shazia Saqib. SIR offers BS Computer Science, ADP Computer Science, Post-ADP Computer Science, and MS Computer Science programs focused on Programming, AI, Robotics, and Data-Driven Innovation, with modern labs, project-based learning, and industry linkages including internships and industry projects.
